generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: 35.5 kWh lithium-ion pack, about 40-50 kW DC (Wikipedia says 40 kW), 6.6 kW on-board charger, CCS1. US: MY2022-2023 (California-focused; sales ended Jul 2023). Canada: MY2022-2024. No pack or charger change found. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mazda_MX-30
